purpose: phase-1 axis-wise offline evaluation of Fly heads (F1) and Fly similar-case retrieval (F2) on saved data only; two separate targets with separate evaluations; no aggregate, no operation

mechanics_code.use: features, labels, gated_label, availability, envelope, retrieve exactly as reviewed; experiment code imports this file after a hash check and adds only data loading, encoder construction, head fitting and scoring

generated_paths.observed: observed/{path_id}.npz O,C int64 (hashes in manifest; verified before use)
generated_paths.hidden: hidden/{path_id}.npz regime int8 read ONLY to build training/evaluation targets for the state heads; never an inference input; never read by the forward-risk or retrieval code paths
generated_paths.splits: manifest split field: train_000..059 (fit), check_000..019 (known combinations, new seeds), test_000..019 (unseen combinations); split by whole path before any windowing
generated_paths.calendar: the 5,938 real session labels carried by the manifest (time axis only)

real_prices.vintage_mode: retrospective_latest_vintage for every real record; effective fetch time = earliest of the two file fields; last complete session 2026-11-05 (the 2026-11-06 row is dropped as incomplete); availability of labels is modeled as event end + 60 s (regular-session assumption, declared, not proof)
real_prices.limitation: latest-vintage adjusted history; no point-in-time claim

flybrake.reused_semantics: wiring(kind) PN->KC extraction with row normalisation and the per-row degree-matched rewiring control; kc(): relu projection, top-k sparse code, L2 normalisation; no reuse of the avoid readout, theta homeostasis, the 60-minute panel, data.py scaling or env.py

connectome.roles: PN 344, KC 2597 (2356 receive PN input), used PN->KC edges 10304 per bill inventory

not_used_in_phase_1: B fits/result 0b10b9da (comparison with B belongs to a later aggregate phase)

feature_vector.definition: council_io.features(closes, D) on the adjusted close series (real) or the generated close series (generated; adjusted = raw by generator assumption); 10 dims in the frozen order; a session is eligible only when features return status ok (>= 200 closes, finite, sd20 > 0); the same eligibility mask is used by every compared method
feature_vector.real_eligible_sessions: D >= 199 and D <= index of 2026-11-05; scored window starts at the first decision strictly after 2014-12-30

encoder_versions.scaler: per-feature mean and population std computed on eligible real sessions D <= 2014-12-30 only (train prefix); applied to real and generated inputs alike; arrays stored and hashed; a zero std feature would abort (not expected)
encoder_versions.projection_P: Gaussian matrix (n_PN = 344) x 10, entries N(0, 1/10), drawn from numpy default_rng(SeedSequence([20261107, 'P', replicate])) with the integer encoding of 'P' declared in code; shared by the connectome and rewired variants of the same replicate

wiring.connectome: flybrake.wiring('connectome') semantics re-implemented in the experiment code against mb_right.npz (hash checked), row-normalised
wiring.rewired_control: per-row degree-matched random rewiring with a separate stream SeedSequence([20261107, 'W', replicate]); same P, same scaler, same data order and same readout initialisation as the paired connectome variant

encoder_versions.activation: pn = relu(x_scaled @ P.T); a = pn @ W.T - theta with theta = 0 (fixed, no homeostasis in phase 1); top-k with k = floor(0.05 x 2597) = 129; z = sparse(a) / ||.||2; z is zero only if a has no positive entry, in which case the session abstains for the Fly heads and is excluded from retrieval (counted)
encoder_versions.identity: encoder_version_id = sha256 over (encoder code version string, feature order list, scaler mean/std arrays, P bytes, W bytes, theta bytes, k, activation constants, connectome file sha); every code cache file names its version id; codes of different versions are never compared
encoder_versions.versions_count: 2 wirings x 5 replicates (0..4) = 10 encoder versions; F2 uses the connectome version of replicate 0 only

encoding_budget.codes_per_version: real eligible sessions (about 5,739) + generated 100 paths x eligible sessions (about 573,900) = about 579,600 codes
encoding_budget.total: about 5.8 million codes over 10 versions; matrix products on CPU, float32, 1 thread; no learning in encoding
encoding_budget.cache: work/council_phase1_f1f2_v1/codes/{version_id}/{real|path_id}.npz written once (xb) with version id and source hashes

F1_state_heads.target: S_generated_state_at_D mapped down={descent,crash}, up={ascent,rebound}, neutral={sideways,highvol} (declared mapping, not a market truth); labels from hidden/*.npz at D; training only on train_000..059; evaluation on check and test paths separately
learners_per_replicate: Fly-connectome: multinomial logistic readout on z (2597 -> 3) with L2 penalty lambda = 1.0 fixed, full-batch L-BFGS or gradient descent with a fixed iteration cap (200), deterministic initialisation 0
Fly-rewired: identical readout on the rewired variant z
native logistic: multinomial logistic on the 10 scaled features (same penalty, same optimiser)
frozen Fly: untrained readout (chance reference, 0 fits)
F1_state_heads.metrics: confusion matrix, per-class precision/recall, macro-F1 on check and on test paths separately; per-combination breakdown; no real-market claim; no threshold selection
F1_state_heads.limitation: there is no real current-trend ground truth; this head is scored only against generated regimes

F1_forward_risk_heads.target: E_close20 on real sessions: event iff min_{s=D+1..D+20} C_s/C_D - 1 <= -0.05 (council_io.label_e_close20); label availability (replay) = close of D+20 + 60 s via council_io.gated_label; a label is usable for a fit only if its availability <= the fit cutoff time
F1_forward_risk_heads.folds: yearly cutoffs identical to the B schedule: fit at the modeled confirmation time of the last session before the first session of execution year y (2015..2026); training rows = eligible real sessions whose E_close20 availability <= that cutoff; scoring rows = eligible sessions in year y; 12 folds
learners_per_replicate: Fly-connectome: logistic readout on z with L2 lambda = 1.0, iteration cap 200, init 0
Fly-rewired: identical on the rewired z
native logistic on the 10 scaled features (replicate-independent, computed once and reported with every replicate)

T_forward_LightGBM on the 10 features: binary objective, the M2 tree parameters (num_leaves 7, depth 3, lr .05, min_leaf 200, l2 1, 200 rounds, seed 0, 1 thread, deterministic), computed once (not replicate-dependent); included as the numeric comparison expert if bill agrees, else dropped
F1_forward_risk_heads.fits: Fly 2 x 12 x 5 = 120; native logistic 12; LightGBM 12; total 144 (132 without LightGBM)
F1_forward_risk_heads.outputs_per_row: council_io envelope records: axis_id, market_as_of D, decision_at = modeled confirmation of D, vintage_mode retrospective_latest_vintage, value_type scalar_score (logistic output reported as score; calibration_status uncalibrated), target_id E_close20, horizon 20
F1_forward_risk_heads.metrics: per year and overall: precision/recall/false-alarm rate at two predeclared operating points (score >= 0.5; score in the top decile of that year's scores), log-loss and Brier computed but labelled uncalibrated, detection delay (sessions from the first warning to the event start) and warning persistence; chronological yearly blocks; no selection on test
F1_forward_risk_heads.limitation: forward events on latest-vintage history; retrospective; overlapping windows inflate apparent sample size (reported as yearly blocks only)

F2_retrieval_audit.encoder: connectome version of replicate 0 (scaler from the <= 2014-12-30 prefix)
F2_retrieval_audit.queries: every eligible real decision session D in the scored window (first decision > 2014-12-30 .. 2026-11-05), about 2,900
F2_retrieval_audit.candidates: real sessions s with E_close20 label availability (replay clock) <= decision_at of D, s < D, same encoder version, finite non-zero code, outcome {event, ret20, max_dd} from council_io labels; council_io.retrieve with k = 10, min_separation = 21, target E_close20
F2_retrieval_audit.diagnostics: for each D: returned_count, similarity spread, outcome distribution of returned cases (event share, median ret20, median max_dd) vs the realised E_close20 at D; aggregate by year: calibration-style table of retrieved event share vs realised event rate (descriptive), coverage statistics, spacing audit; no learning, no decision
F2_retrieval_audit.runs: about 2,900 retrievals x up to about 5,700 candidates cosine similarity; CPU seconds

common_controls.replicates: ids 0..4; paired randomness per contract; identical seed integers are not shared between LightGBM and Fly, only replicate ids
common_controls.data_order: fixed chronological order for all fits
common_controls.selection: no winner selection on test; all operating points and penalties fixed above

label_purge: real folds: a training row is admitted only if gated_label returns status available at the fit cutoff (modeled replay clock); scoring rows of year y never enter the fit of year y; generated paths: split by path, no purge needed across paths, but the state label at D is used only for sessions eligible by features

budget.estimated_wall: under 15 minutes (logistic fits on 2,597-dim codes with at most ~5,700 rows dominate)

outputs.results: council_phase1_f1f2_results.json written once (xb) with contract/code/input hashes, encoder version ids, all per-fold metrics, per-replicate tables, F2 diagnostics and the limitations text
outputs.runlog: work/council_phase1_f1f2_runlog_<UTC>.json outside the output directory with before/after hashes of code, inputs and connectome
outputs.selftests: fixture-only (toy connectome of a few neurons, toy paths <= 64 rows) before approval: encoder determinism and version id sensitivity, rewiring degree match, scaler from prefix only, purge by availability clock, fold boundaries, retrieval candidate clocks; no real data beyond hashes and calendar

limitations_stated_in_results: no real current-trend ground truth: state heads are scored only on generated regimes under a declared mapping
forward-risk results are retrospective on latest-vintage data with overlapping windows
encoding and fitting on generated and viewed real history cannot establish a future advantage
connectome vs rewired differences, if any, are reported with paired replicate variability; no significance claim
F2 similarity is resemblance, not prediction; k and similarity are not confidence
open_for_bill: include T_forward_LightGBM (12 fits) as the numeric comparison expert in phase 1, or defer
readout learner: L2 multinomial/binary logistic with lambda 1.0 and 200 iterations (drafted) vs the original delta rule (online) which the contract classes as training with maturity controls
theta fixed at 0 (drafted) vs a snapshot from a short warm-up on the prefix
replicates 0..4 for both heads (drafted) vs 0..2 for the forward head to halve the fit count
